_about: Market numbers for each area guide, from Ryth's MLS. Leave a guide at null and its 'Market numbers' section stays hidden. To fill one, replace null with: { "median": 315000, "sold": 412, "dom": 45, "scope": "Single-family homes and condos sold in Stroud Township, Stroudsburg and East Stroudsburg", "period": "October 2025 to September 2026", "source": "Pocono Mountains MLS, pulled October 2026" } (median = median sale price, sold = homes sold in the last 12 months, dom = average days on market). The Spanish page shows the same numbers; add "scopeEs", "periodEs" and "sourceEs" to give those three lines in Spanish (without them the English text is used). "place" and "placeEs" name the area in the automatic question "What is the median home price in …?" that the page adds to its Questions when it has numbers. Entries can also be areas without a guide of their own (for example "mount-pocono" or "easton"): guides list them in their front matter ("prices: monroe-county, mount-pocono") and show them in a price table with {{prices}}; an area listed there with no entry yet is simply left out of the table.
